On stop it may signal only same PID+birth+PPID+PGID+SID still unreaped; no group signal. TERM then KILL after 4 seconds, bounded wait 5.5 seconds from signal. KILL never proves query groups closed; parent errors, missing identity/join/summary, timeout and descendant escape remain UNKNOWN. On a positive observer result, observer self PID/start/PPID/parent birth/PGID/SID and all three query join records must match the gated direct child and recorded parent.
